verdict.summary: Round 2 remains correct and complete. The workflow uses a real GitHub-hosted aarch64 runner, fails closed unless the host is aarch64 with ASIMD, enables the feature that compiles the SIMD dispatcher and kernels, verifies that the relevant tests are actually present in the nextest inventory, and runs the full sparq-vectors suite for the selected features. The path filters, least-privilege permissions, concurrency, action pinning, timeout, and cache scope are coherent. The unsafe-register edits accurately characterize the new execution evidence without claiming that numeric testing proves memory safety. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect was found. Because round 1 also had no findings, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
